scope: Exact current twelve-manuscript launch documentary triage; no manuscript or founder approval hashes changed

policy_basis.decision: Existing policy requires human professional review for prescriptive or site-specific regulated claims, not every documentary trade article. These revisions report attributed source claims and planning questions without certifying an installation. Conditional triggers below preserve that boundary.
policy_basis.not_a_signoff: No licensed engineer, independent reviewer, model test, field inspection, manufacturer endorsement or publication authorization is invented.

evidence_limitations: Some source checks explicitly use existing November 10/11 companion evidence; they are not relabeled as fresh live retrieval.
Live source retrieval can expose different regional product literature. Exact revision and geography must remain attached to claims.
This report clears only stated documentary scope. It does not replace separate exact-image composition/rights records or founder release authorization.
